name: orca-workflows
description: Workflows that run coding agents through Orca. rather-than-me sends one brief to frontier models made by other AI labs, collects their independent reviews and compares them with its own view. issue-autopilot sets up a scheduled Orca automation that implements a repo's GitHub issues one at a time from a runbook, each in a fresh worktree ending in a PR. Works from Claude Code and Codex. Requires Orca.
